notes.title: Maid_san's Caving Adventure Images released!
notes.content:
Maid_san's Caving Adventure image material
Maid_san's Caving Adventure Images has been released!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29163768/7d4f7b2b9b3b2ea5ec07639dc0d92bb665157159.jpg[/img]

It is difficult to draw images of action games!
By using this image material you can easily create a stage for action games!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29163768/cfa492c864ccad36095a076d38d004e76bcd25d6.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29163768/00954d2f409d1ee134a3ff7e3badd2f689a102e9.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29163768/29fd2dcb1ea49d27966e828915b4d4fd9cb15450.jpg[/img]

Various stages can be made depending on the ingenuity.
Although there is no plan to respond to image creation requests,
You may add images of games that were discontinued.


It is such image material.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29163768/96a405c2781b1590c3e49c743fdb9a2110c0f0b3.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29163768/767e9d571507384a7a2240096cc25dc624a63c9c.jpg[/img]

Although the original data was large and it was not organized,
If there are many additional hopes as materials, I will do my best and organize it!
